heading.purpose: One per page, top of the content column.

data.purpose: Order numbers, IDs, prices, counts, dates inside tables.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus, popovers, dialogs, and the mobile sidebar sheet only — never resting cards.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for color/border/opacity state changes (hover, focus, active).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one blue action per view — submit, create, confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881) 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881 / 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Secondary/tertiary row and header actions (edit, delete, menu trigger) — the interface's default button.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Edit"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17 3a2.85 2.83 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.4rem; border: none; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.014 258); transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.968 0.003 258); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881 / 50%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default field control, paired with an explicit label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.18 0.014 258); } .ds-input { height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.916 0.008 258); background: transparent; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.18 0.014 258); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.51 0.017 258); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881 / 50%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The only container surface; flat, bordered, never shadowed at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(1 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.916 0.008 258); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: oklch(0.546 0.245 262.881 / 40%); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.51 0.017 258); margin: 0 0 0.125rem; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.18 0.014 258); margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Order/event state pill. Green = positive/live, amber = pending/draft, gray = closed, red = failed/expired. Never rendered in the brand blue.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { background: oklch(0.977 0.03 155 / 40%); color: #047857; } .ds-badge-warning { background: oklch(0.97 0.05 90 / 40%); color: #b45309; } .ds-badge-neutral { background: oklch(0.968 0.003 258); color: oklch(0.51 0.017 258); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Icon + label nav row; active state uses Cool Mist background and Terminal-Blue-tinted text, never a bare blue fill.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.24 0.02 258 / 70%); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.965 0.02 255 / 60%); color: oklch(0.24 0.02 258); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: oklch(0.965 0.02 255); color: oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376); }

narrative.overview: This is not a designed world — it's a deliberate refusal of one. Offered a set of distinctive visual directions rooted in the ticketing/box-office domain (terminal wayfinding signage, ticket-stub ledgers), the product owner chose the category-standard admin convention instead, explicitly asking for something that looks like admin dashboards in general. The craft bar is Linear: generous whitespace, precise type, a single restrained blue accent, and components executed at default radius without ornament. Nothing here should surprise a user who has used any modern SaaS admin panel before. The palette is Restrained: near-white and near-black neutrals carry the interface, with one blue reserved for primary actions, the current navigation item, links, and focus rings. A second, barely-cooler neutral distinguishes the sidebar from the content area without introducing a second brand color. Status (order/event state) uses a small, standardized semantic vocabulary — green/amber/neutral/red — never the brand blue, so state and action never compete for the same signal.
keyCharacteristics: One sans family (Geist Sans) for every UI role; monospace (Geist Mono) reserved for order numbers and tabular numeric data.
Fixed rem type scale, not fluid — a desktop admin tool viewed at consistent DPI.
Default shadcn/ui component radius and elevation; no custom chrome invented for flavor.
Blue is functional, not decorative: primary actions, active nav, links, focus rings, and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Terminal Blue appears only on primary actions, the active nav item, links, and focus rings. It never appears as a status color, a decorative fill, or a hover tint outside those roles.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: One sans carries the whole interface. A second display face is never introduced for a heading, a button, or a stat number.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Static surfaces (cards, table containers, the sidebar) separate from the page with a 1px border. Shadow is reserved for content that floats above the layout: menus, dialogs, sheets.

dos: Do keep Terminal Blue to primary actions, the active nav item, links, and focus rings only.
Do use the status badge vocabulary (green/amber/neutral/red) for every order/event state, and only for state.
Do separate static surfaces with a 1px Hairline border, not a shadow.
Do pair every form input with an explicit visible label via Field/FieldLabel.
Do route every delete action through ConfirmDialog before the mutation fires.
donts: Don't introduce a second display font or a second brand accent color — this system is deliberately one voice, one blue.
Don't add shadows to resting cards, the sidebar, or the table container.
Don't use Terminal Blue as a status/semantic color.
Don't fire a destructive mutation directly from a row action without the confirm dialog.
